host.board: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit

isaac_sim.discovery: robot_lab_utils.isaac_env.find_isaac_python: ISAAC_PYTHON, then ISAAC_SIM_PATH, then known install roots
isaac_sim.required_preload: Isaac's bundled extsDeprecated/omni.isaac.ml_archive/pip_prebundle/nvidia/nvjitlink/lib/libnvJitLink.so.12 before the system CUDA 12.6 copy (robot_lab_utils.isaac_env.isaac_preload_libraries)
